---

I like taking a problem from a napkin sketch all the way to production, then keeping it running.

30+ years building software and IT systems: I've founded and run technology companies, led
engineering teams of up to 50 people, and today I build business-critical applications as an
IT consultant and software engineer. I'm happiest at the seam between **software, hardware,
and the cloud** — barcode and auto-ID products, embedded devices, and AI-assisted applications.

---

### 🧰 What I work on

| Area | Highlights |
|---|---|
| **Full-stack & .NET** | C#, .NET 8/10 & .NET Framework/Core, ASP.NET Core/MVC, Blazor, WPF, WinForms, EF Core, REST/GraphQL, microservices |
| **Web & front-end** | React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), Tailwind, Bootstrap, HTML5/CSS3, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC |
| **Cloud & DevOps** | Azure (Functions, Entra ID, M365), AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins & Azure DevOps CI/CD, HA/disaster recovery |
| **Data** | SQL Server (T-SQL), PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB, data modeling & migration |
| **AI & automation** | LLM integration (OpenAI & Anthropic APIs), local models via Ollama, MCP servers, AI coding & agent design |
| **Embedded & IoT** | ESP8266/ESP32 & Arduino, CAN-Bus, sensor and control hardware, 3D CAD & rapid prototyping |
| **Leadership** | Founding teams, roadmaps and budgets ($5M+), vendor negotiation, legacy modernization, mentoring |

### 💡 Interests

Barcode and auto-ID technology · embedded hardware and sensors · local-first AI and agents ·
open-source tooling · 3D printing and CAD · making classical Chinese texts readable for
modern audiences · and the occasional excuse to write firmware for a device that beeps.

### 🧭 Background

Currently an **IT consultant and software engineer** building Windows, mobile, and
multi-platform applications (AI customer support, MCP servers, REST APIs, and .NET Framework →
.NET 10 migrations). Previously **founder & CEO of IBE Group** (2004–2024), shipping hundreds of
OEM desktop and mobile applications for clients including Asus, Dell, and Toshiba America, and
earlier founder/CTO of Gopher King and ODF Technologies. Earlier in my career I ran IT
departments in law firms and research institutes.

- 🎓 MS Chemistry, UC Berkeley · BS Computer Science & BS Chemistry, Nankai University
- 📍 Fremont, California
